messages.content:
You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value, sometimes a condition, and the place it comes from.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the facts, step by step: a repeal or a
  limit "from 20 January" does not yet apply on 16 January.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the facts.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- Return JSON only:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: How often must the DEMAG overhead travelling crane at position 8 of the IGEA lifting equipment list be verified?

Facts:
[0] 4.3.3 lifting machinery, maximum working load — requiresMeasure — prominently marked (prominently marked) [REG, Annex III, 4.3.3]
[1] lifting machinery maximum working load — requiresMeasure — prominently marked (prominently marked) [DIR, Annex I, 4.3.3]
[2] regular inspection of machinery or related product — verifiedBy — designated bodies (designated bodies) [condition: may be subject to national requirements for regular inspection] [REG, Annex III, 2.4.10]
[3] datore di lavoro, controllo dopo ogni montaggio — hasObligation — dopo ogni montaggio in un nuovo cantiere o in una nuova località di impianto (dopo ogni montaggio in un nuovo cantiere o in una nuova località di impianto) [condition: attrezzature di lavoro la cui sicurezza dipende dalle condizioni di installazione] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 8]
[4] lifting machinery — mustAccompany — a test report (a test report) [condition: where appropriate] [REG, Annex III, 4.4.2]
[5] lifting machinery — mustAccompany — a test report detailing the static and dynamic tests (test report on static and dynamic tests) [condition: where appropriate] [DIR, Annex I, 4.4.2]
[6] Dynamic test — definedAs — the test during which lifting machinery is operated in all its possible configurations (the test during which lifting machinery is operated in all its possible configurations) [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.1]
[7] lifting machinery — mustAccompany — a copy of the load plate or load table (a copy of the load plate or load table) [condition: where appropriate] [REG, Annex III, 4.4.2]
[8] vehicle servicing lifts — listedIn — Vehicle servicing lifts (annex IV point 16) [DIR, Annex IV]
[9] lifting machinery marking — requiresMeasure — legible, indelible and in an un-coded form (legible, indelible and in an un-coded form) [DIR, Annex I, 4.3.3]
[10] periodic verifications of comma 11 for equipment in annex VII — verifiedBy — Corpo nazionale dei vigili del fuoco (Corpo nazionale dei vigili del fuoco) [condition: relativamente alle attrezzature riportate nell'allegato VII di cui dispone a titolo di proprietà o comodato d'uso] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 13-bis]
[11] 4.3.3 machinery with configuration-dependent working load — requiresMeasure — load plate (load plate) [condition: Where the maximum working load depends on the configuration of the lifting machinery or related product] [REG, Annex III, 4.3.3]
[12] vehicle servicing lifts — listedIn — Vehicle servicing lifts (vehicle servicing lifts) [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 3]
[13] lifting machinery working load per configuration — requiresMeasure — load plate (load plate) [condition: Where the maximum working load depends on the configuration of the machinery] [DIR, Annex I, 4.3.3]
[14] loading control — requiresMeasure — fitted with devices to warn the driver and prevent dangerous movements (fitted with devices to warn the driver and prevent dangerous movements) [condition: Machinery with a maximum working load of not less than 1 000 kilograms or an overturning moment of not less than 40 000 Nm] [DIR, Annex I, 4.2.2]
[15] movement of the machinery — requiresMeasure — must depend on safe positioning (must depend on safe positioning) [condition: Where it does not give rise to other risks] [DIR, Annex I, 3.3.2]
[16] internal parts requiring frequent inspection and adjustment, and maintenance areas — requiresMeasure — appropriate lighting (appropriate lighting) [DIR, Annex I, 1.1.4]
[17] devices for the lifting of persons or of persons and goods — listedIn — 14. (annex I, part B, point 14) [condition: involving a hazard of falling from a vertical height of more than 3 m] [REG, Annex I, Part B, point 14]
[18] loading control 4.2.2 — requiresMeasure — devices to warn the driver and prevent dangerous movements (devices to warn the driver and prevent dangerous movements) [condition: with a maximum working load of not less than 1 000 kg or an overturning moment of not less than 40 000 Nm] [REG, Annex III, 4.2.2]
[19] lifting machinery — mustAccompany — contents of the logbook (contents of the logbook) [condition: if the latter is not supplied with the lifting machinery] [REG, Annex III, 4.4.2]
[20] guards for moving transmission parts with frequent access — requiresMeasure — Interlocking movable guards (interlocking movable guards) [condition: where frequent access is envisaged] [DIR, Annex I, 1.3.8.1]
[21] guards at landings — requiresMeasure — interlocking device controlled by the position of the carrier (interlocking device controlled by the position of the carrier) [condition: hazardous movements of the carrier until the guards are closed and locked] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.8.5]
[22] Static test — definedAs — the test during which lifting machinery or a lifting accessory is first inspected (the test during which lifting machinery or a lifting accessory is first inspected) [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.1]
[23] machinery referred to in Annex IV — requiresProcedure — internal checks on the manufacture of machinery (internal checks on the manufacture of machinery) [condition: provided that those standards cover all of the relevant essential health and safety requirements] [DIR, Art. 12(3)]
[24] machinery running on guide rails — requiresMeasure — devices must be provided which prevent the equipment, component or load from falling or the machinery from overturning (devices must be provided which prevent the equipment, component or load from falling or the machinery from overturning) [condition: If, despite such devices, there remains a risk of derailment or of failure of a rail or of a running component] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.2]
[25] 4.3.3 lifting goods-only machinery with carrier allowing access to persons — requiresMeasure — clear and indelible warning prohibiting the lifting of persons (clear and indelible warning prohibiting the lifting of persons) [condition: Machinery or related products intended for lifting goods only, equipped with a carrier, which allows access to persons] [REG, Annex III, 4.3.3]
[26] essential requirement 1.6.2, access to operating positions and servicing points — requiresMeasure — allow access in safety (allow access in safety) [condition: where intervention is necessary during operation, adjustment and maintenance of the machinery] [DIR, Annex I, 1.6.2]
[27] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — conformity based on unit verification (module G) (conformity based on unit verification (module g)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[28] 4.1.2.7 operating position of machinery — requiresMeasure — widest possible view of trajectories (widest possible view of trajectories) [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.7]
[29] manufacturer — hasObligation — perform appropriate tests, or have such tests performed (perform appropriate tests, or have such tests performed) [condition: In order to verify that the relevant parts of the machinery or related product comply with the requirements set out in sections 2.4.5.1 and 2.4.5.2, for each type of machinery or related product concerned] [REG, Annex III, 2.4.5.3]
[30] essential requirement 6.4.3, access to the carrier — requiresMeasure — guards at the landings and on the carrier (guards at the landings and on the carrier) [condition: taking into consideration the foreseeable range of goods and persons to be lifted] [DIR, Annex I, 6.4.3]
[31] machine part mass — hasObligation — its mass must be indicated (its mass must be indicated) [condition: where a machine part must be handled during use with lifting equipment] [DIR, Annex I, 1.7.3]
[32] lifting machinery or related products — mustAccompany — instructions for use (instructions for use) [REG, Annex III, 4.4.2]
[33] portable hand-held machinery — requiresMeasure — visual observation of the danger zone (visual observation of the danger zone) [condition: where necessary] [REG, Annex III, 2.2.1]
[34] machinery serving fixed landings — listedIn — 6.4. (Annex I, point 6.4) [DIR, Annex I, 6.4]
[35] essential requirement 1.1.5, machinery handling — requiresMeasure — attachments for lifting gear (attachments for lifting gear) [condition: Where the weight, size or shape of machinery or its various component parts prevents them from being moved by hand] [DIR, Annex I, 1.1.5]
[36] driver checking position of devices exceeding clearance zone — requiresMeasure — the means of checking easily (the means of checking easily) [condition: Where, for operating purposes, machinery is fitted with devices which exceed its normal clearance zone] [DIR, Annex I, 3.3.2]
[37] 4.1.2.2 machinery running on guide rails — requiresMeasure — devices, which act on the guide rails (devices, which act on the guide rails) [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.2]
[38] machinery and lifting accessories — addressesRisk — failure from fatigue and wear (failure from fatigue and wear) [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.3]
[39] movement of the carrier of machinery serving fixed landings — requiresMeasure — rigidly guided (rigidly guided) [condition: to and at the landings] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.8.1]
[40] guards for moving transmission parts — requiresMeasure — Interlocking movable guards shall be used (interlocking movable guards shall be used) [condition: where frequent access is envisaged] [REG, Annex III, 1.3.8.1]
[41] devices for lifting persons or persons and goods — listedIn — Devices for the lifting of persons or of persons and goods (annex IV point 17) [condition: involving a hazard of falling from a vertical height of more than three metres] [DIR, Annex IV]
[42] machinery referred to in Annex IV — requiresProcedure — full quality assurance (full quality assurance) [DIR, Annex X]
[43] control devices for carrier movements — requiresMeasure — control devices authorising automatic stops at preselected positions (control devices authorising automatic stops at preselected positions) [condition: If there is no risk of persons or objects on the carrier colliding or falling and no other risks due to the upward and downward movements of the carrier] [REG, Annex III, 6.2]
[44] adjustment and maintenance points — requiresMeasure — must be located outside danger zones (must be located outside danger zones) [DIR, Annex I, 1.6.1]
[45] movable guards — requiresMeasure — guard locking device (guard locking device) [condition: Where it is possible for an operator to reach the danger zone before the risk due to the hazardous machinery functions has ceased] [DIR, Annex I, 1.4.2.2]
[46] lifting machinery with carrier allowing access to persons — requiresMeasure — clear and indelible warning prohibiting the lifting of persons (clear and indelible warning prohibiting the lifting of persons) [condition: Machinery intended for lifting goods only, equipped with a carrier which allows access to persons] [DIR, Annex I, 4.3.3]
[47] distributors — hasObligation — distributors shall verify that (verify that machinery bears the CE marking) [condition: Before making machinery or a related product available on the market] [REG, Art. 15(2)]
[48] relevant technical documentation for partly completed machinery — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [DIR, Annex VII]
[49] Lifting operation — definedAs — a movement of unit loads (a movement of unit loads) [REG, Annex III, 4.1]

response.text: {"kind":"unknown","value":null,"text":"The facts do not say how often the DEMAG overhead travelling crane at position 8 of the IGEA lifting equipment list must be verified. Fact 10 names the Corpo nazionale dei vigili del fuoco for periodic verifications of Annex VII equipment, but gives no frequency.","used":[10]}
